title: Canonical structured evidence for Hostinger guards

phases.objective: Route Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard through the registered trusted CI Evidence PR Publisher, with an exact-head E2E fallback when the direct Tenant workflow_run subscription is not delivered, without granting repository/runtime mutation authority or creating a competing comment surface.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted workflow_run publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A completed Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard run and the matching completed E2E Phase Governance run for the same exact head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted main-based CI Evidence PR Publisher discovers or directly receives the exact-head Tenant Canary run, validates its run-bound canonical artifact, and updates the shared authoritative PR comment.
steps: Accept a direct completed Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard workflow_run when GitHub delivers it.
When E2E Phase Governance completes, query the Hostinger workflow runs API for one successful pull_request run with the same full head SHA and head branch.
Skip fallback publication when no exact-head Tenant Canary run exists.
Download only the run-bound hostinger-storage-tenant-canary summary artifact for the discovered run ID.
Validate workflow and guard identity, contract, candidate kind, exact candidate SHA, check counts, result count, first failure, secrets declaration, and job_logs_consulted=false.
Resolve exactly one open or merged PR from event PR number or exact repository, branch, and head SHA.
Reject stale, substituted, ambiguous, or closed-unmerged PR identities.
Add or replace only the Hostinger Tenant Canary section inside the existing mad4b canonical evidence comment.
assertions: The source and report workflow is Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and guard_key is hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The sole publisher workflow is CI Evidence PR Publisher.
Fallback discovery filters event=pull_request, status=completed, exact head_sha, exact workflow name, success conclusion, and matching head branch.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals the E2E workflow_run head SHA.
Passed evidence requires all selected checks to pass, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
The report declares secrets_included=false and job_logs_consulted=false.
The publisher runs from trusted main with actions:read, issues:write, pull-requests:write, contents:read, and persist-credentials:false.
No specialized Hostinger publisher remains registered and the PR-head Tenant Canary Guard receives no comment-write authority.
No deployment, provider call, credential access, migration, SQL, external send, Production mutation, protected-branch mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Run 30729520216 proved the post-convergence Tenant Canary Artifact on head 5a523d4c124507de05b5077e4aec71c2a22f1d4e with 8/8 passing checks, but the direct Tenant workflow_run subscription did not update the comment while the E2E publisher did. Complete the operational phase by proving the exact-head E2E fallback publishes the same run-bound Hostinger evidence.
blockers: The exact-head E2E fallback has not reached main and published a real Hostinger section yet.

phases.objective: Exercise missing Tenant runs, artifact absence, malformed JSON, stale SHA, branch mismatch, workflow identity mismatch, conflicting counts, ambiguous PR resolution, cancelled runs, and publisher retries while keeping Job logs diagnostic-only.
Extend the same bounded exact-head fallback contract to Shared Canary and Production Preflight only after Tenant Canary publication is proven end to end.
This repository evidence publisher grants no runtime, Hostinger, deployment, migration, or Production authority.
